issues.description: validate_conda uses substring match on --version output, accepting impostor binaries
issues.detail: `any(tool in out.decode().lower() for tool in ['micromamba', 'mamba', 'conda'])` matches the substring anywhere in output, so binaries like 'anaconda-client' or anything containing 'mamba' pass. Check the basename of the executable or parse the first token of stdout for an exact identity check.

issues.description: filters='*.exe' bakes a Windows assumption into a cross-platform config
issues.detail: On macOS and Linux, conda/mamba/micromamba are typically extensionless, so the file picker shows nothing. The 'Conda executable' abstraction should be platform-neutral. Make the filter platform-conditional or drop it.

issues.description: custom_conda boolean + conda_path string encode the same state twice
issues.detail: The flag adds no information the path doesn't already carry, creating two sources of truth that can drift. Treat a non-empty conda_path as the override (or use Optional[str] with None meaning unset) and drop custom_conda. The kernelspec fallback chain would then collapse into a flat `find_conda() or user_path or error`.

issues.description: validate_conda returns True for empty input, conflating 'unset' with 'valid'
issues.detail: Callers expecting 'True implies usable executable' get a false positive on empty strings, and a stale or broken persisted path is consumed downstream by kernelspec without re-validation. Split the predicate or treat empty as a precondition violation handled at the call site, and re-check on use.

issues.description: create_browsefile gains validate_callback/validate_reason with no documented contract
issues.detail: The new parameters are added without specifying the callback signature, return semantics, or when validation fires (on edit, on save, on load). Future implementers and callers will diverge. Add a short docstring spec stating the contract and time semantics.

issues.description: setFocus() added unconditionally to shared select_file helper for one caller
issues.detail: The focus side effect now fires for every existing create_browsefile in the app to serve this one new field, complecting file-selection with widget-focus policy in a generic helper. Make it opt-in via a parameter or attach the focus behavior locally to the new conda field.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the feature is small and roughly shaped right, but the implementation has avoidable hygiene problems. validate_conda is the central concern: substring matching admits impostor binaries, and returning True on empty input conflates 'unset' with 'valid'. The custom_conda boolean duplicates state already carried by conda_path, and the '*.exe' filter silently breaks the picker on macOS and Linux. Secondary concerns include an undocumented validate_callback contract on create_browsefile and a setFocus() side effect smuggled into a shared helper. Tighten the validator, collapse the dual-flag config, fix the filter, and document the new widget contract.
